title: a probe's enough threshold declares what set it
intention: a probe's enough threshold declares what set it
what: A probe's 'enough' threshold is set once by whoever wrote the probe and never moves against evidence, so 55 hand-typed numbers across 47 probes decide when the system has learned enough — and the ratified intention that says thresholds move with evidence has no code face at all.
why: A probe's `enough` is the number that decides when the system stops watching and calls a thing settled. 55 of them are typed once by whoever wrote the probe and never move again — so the watches clear on somebody's first guess, and 34 of the 47 files do not even carry a comment saying the number was a guess. The lived symptom is a green that means 'the author picked 3' rather than 'we saw enough'. I-learns-its-gates has been RATIFIED since 2026-07-16 saying thresholds move with evidence, and has no code face at all.
how: MEASURED FIRST, and the measurement reshaped the ticket: 55 numeric `_ENOUGH*` constants across 47 probe files, of which only 13 files carry the comment naming the debt. The other 34 hold identical hand-set numbers with no comment at all — the IOU was declared where somebody happened to remember, not where the debt is, which is exactly why prose cannot be the record. Approach, and it is deliberately NOT 'build the confidence engine': (1) make the threshold DECLARED rather than typed — a probe's `enough` becomes a field on the frozen Probe (`cairn/tools/base/probe.py`) carrying the number AND the ticket or observation that set it, so a threshold with no provenance is refusable; (2) a sieve counts probes whose threshold has no provenance, which turns 34 invisible sites into a number that can go down; (3) ONLY THEN does moving them against evidence become buildable, because you cannot move what you cannot enumerate. Do not build (3) here. The 5000-beat constants and the 1/12 rate in a_pickup_is_witnessed are the interesting cases to read while designing the field — they are not sample sizes at all, and a field shaped only for 'how many observations' will force them to lie.
traces_to: I-learns-its-gates (CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/I-learns-its-gates.md, RATIFIED by Akien 2026-07-16): 'for every gate the system holds a confidence that acting alone is safe, and it moves that confidence with evidence.' A hand-typed constant is a confidence that cannot move. Also Law 4 — the rule is real and enforced by nothing but the author's memory — and Law 3, since 'enough' is a claim about when a measurement is trustworthy and 55 of them are unmeasured.
falsifier: DONE when every probe's `enough` threshold is a declared field carrying its provenance, when a sieve reports the count of provenance-less thresholds, and when that count is 0. HORIZON: the sieve's own reading. WRONG INTENT if this becomes a build of the confidence engine — the engine is I-learns-its-gates' aim and this ticket is the enumeration that has to exist under it; shipping a mover before an enumeration means it moves the 13 that were commented and silently skips the 34 that were not, which is the same defect one layer up.
children: none, because the enumeration is one field on one primitive plus one sieve. The mover that changes thresholds against evidence is NOT a child — it is a separate later ticket under I-learns-its-gates, and calling it a child here would make this ticket unprovable until the engine exists.

watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier: the provenance-less count, the total probe count, and the count of probes added since the last run
watchme.consumer: whoever builds the confidence engine under I-learns-its-gates — this enumeration is its input
watchme.enough: the count reaches 0 AND holds at 0 across 5 subsequent runs in which at least 2 new probes were added. Holding matters more than reaching: the failure this ticket names is a rule that covers what exists today and lets the 48th probe be born undeclared.
watchme.trigger: each build_inspector run over the corpus — the sieve's own firing

gates_bound.check_type: proofs beside the code, run twice, sealed under the tester with isolation
a red at PROVEME kicks back to this ticket
count probes whose enough threshold carries no provenance; the count must reach 0 over the live corpus
gates_bound.why: this is the physics the IOU owed. A rule that only reaches the 13 sites somebody commented is the prose it replaces, so the gate is the count over ALL 47 files

in: cairn/tools/base/probe.py — the frozen Probe primitive; `enough` gains a value and its provenance while keeping the prose it carries today
the 47 probe files holding 55 numeric _ENOUGH* constants (census by command in the ticket)
cairn/machines/build_inspector/ — the sieve counting provenance-less thresholds
the existing owning_ticket() provenance mechanism, already used by 19 probes — composed, not reinvented
out: THE CONFIDENCE ENGINE — anything that MOVES a threshold against evidence. That is I-learns-its-gates' aim and a separate later ticket. A mover shipped on today's corpus would move the 13 commented sites and silently skip the 34 silent ones, which is this ticket's own defect one layer up.
Sieve bands (0524c3b8b379 KILLED, 16047f83eb88 PROVED) — a different animal: how a sieve reports severity, not when a watch has seen enough.

Computing enough from population size at read time. Rejected on measurement: the 55 are five different kinds of number (count, duration, rate, window, coverage floor) and one rule would be wrong for most of them.

open_for_akien: One, and it is a design detail rather than a spec choice, so my read stands unless you say otherwise: whether `probes_disabled/` is in the corpus the sieve counts. cairn/devices/aider_shim/probes_disabled/reflection_earns_its_ask.py holds _ENOUGH_REFLECTED = 5 in a directory nothing runs. My read: counted but banded separately, because a disabled probe that gets re-enabled carries its undeclared threshold back in with it.

measured_at_cast.kinds_of_number: 5 — count (_ENOUGH_CROSSINGS=20), duration (_ENOUGH_BEATS=5000), rate (_ENOUGH_RATE=1/12), window (_ENOUGH_DAYS=30), coverage floor (_ENOUGH_PER_VERDICT=1)
measured_at_cast.existing_provenance_mechanism: 19 probes carry _OWNING_TICKET and call owning_ticket() — built, and unused for this
measured_at_cast.intention_age: I-learns-its-gates RATIFIED 2026-07-16; zero code faces as of 2026-09-09

decisions.text: D1: Threshold(value, of, set_by) is a frozen dataclass in cairn/tools/base/probe.py and Probe gains thresholds: tuple[Threshold, ...] = (). Construction refuses a Threshold whose of or set_by is blank. value is any scalar (int, float, timedelta, bool or None) so a count, a duration (5000 beats), a rate (1/12), a window (30 days), a coverage floor and a never-clears all fit the field without lying; of says what the number is of, in the probe's own words; the module-level _ENOUGH constant stays the one source of the number and the Threshold cites it.
decisions.step: unlisted: the shape of the declared threshold

decisions.text: D2: the primitive does NOT refuse enough-without-thresholds at construction — the ticket's how names the sieve as the physics, ~100 proofs build bare probes that would red for no design reason, and a construction-time refusal would make the WATCHME's count trivially 0. The refusal is the sieve probe_thresholds_declare_provenance in cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py (registered in SIEVES), one finding per probe in the component's probes/ folder whose Probe( call carries enough= and no thresholds= holding at least one Threshold( with a non-empty set_by. The count is read by an importless AST census in cairn/tools/base/threshold_census.py shared by the sieve and the WATCHME probe (tools/base imports no device).

D3: set_by names the ticket when that ticket's own text names the number; otherwise it says '<ticket> build, number chosen by CC, the ticket names no number'; a probe no ticket bore says 'guess by CC 2026-09-18, no ticket, no observation'. A guess that says so is provenance of origin (Law 10: a recorded observation of who set it is a measurement at n=1); the sieve counts blank set_by, never guessed ones. Separating guessed from measured and moving thresholds against evidence is part (3) and is not built here.

D4: all 104 enough-bearing probes gain thresholds= by a migration script driven by measurement, not by hand: ticket lookup by watchme.probe path (88), then a module TICKET/_OWNING_TICKET constant (15), then the tickets that name the file (18), then none (1: codemother/probes/commit_fires_activations.py); the number-in-ticket check chooses the set_by wording per D3; ambiguous multi-ticket files are settled by hand in the script's table. The 3 probes without enough= gain nothing. probes_disabled/ and proofs/ are outside the census.

D5: measured 2026-09-18 before the build: 81 _?ENOUGH* constants across 67 non-proof files (55/47 at the cast); 107 probe modules under probes/ folders, 104 with enough= in their Probe( call, 3 without; 88 matched to a ticket by watchme.probe, 15 carry a ticket constant, 18 of the remaining 19 are named by a ticket, 1 by none.

D6: the WATCHME probe at cairn/tools/base/probes/a_threshold_without_provenance_is_refusable.py runs the census over the repo root on each pulse and appends {at, provenance_less, total} to runs.jsonl under the holder's instance-space tools/base/threshold_census/ (Law 6: the tool's ongoing state berths under its holder); enough reads the last six lines: five consecutive zeros after a zero, with total grown by at least 2 across them (the cast's own enough). roots= is the proof's isolation seam.
decisions.step: unlisted: the WATCHME probe's cross-run memory

decisions.text: D7: proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_threshold_provenance.py with a PROVES entry for 336a781018ba keyed per proof_coverage.clauses; teeth: a blank of/set_by is refused and a declared one is carried; the census finds the silent probe in a scratch tree and none once declared; the sieve reds a component holding a silent probe and passes a declared one; the live corpus count is 0 (an invariant asserted over live data, never a snapshot); the WATCHME probe is a frozen Probe with carry and enough whose enough turns true only on the sixth run under the cast's clause. Sealed twice bare and hollow.

D8: probes_disabled/ IS in the census, counted but banded separately — the cast's open_for_akien read, standing unless Akien says otherwise, and it applies to the sieve, the WATCHME probe and D6 alike. threshold_census.probe_files walks both probes/ and probes_disabled/ (PROBE_FOLDERS), each row carries disabled: bool, and census() reports disabled_total / disabled_provenance_less / disabled_provenance_less_paths BESIDE total / provenance_less, never folded in; the sieve scans both folders and stamps each finding band='live' or 'disabled'; the WATCHME line carries the disabled band beside the live one. D4's 'probes_disabled/ outside the census' is superseded by this line: the four aider_shim disabled probes were migrated 2026-09-18 by the same script (edit_survival -> 6d3e689b0bf8, offload_yield -> d7b4019d2407 from their own docstrings; reflection_earns_its_ask -> e9b0a8d4fb99; writes_to_is_where_it_landed -> 68f1fc073512), so both bands read 0. Only proofs/ stays outside.

D9: 'watchme.probe' in D4 is a FIELD of a cast ticket, not a version-control lookup: every ticket JSON under CairnCommons/tickets/ may carry a watchme object whose probe key is the repo-relative berth path of that ticket's WATCHME probe module (this ticket's own reads cairn/tools/base/probes/a_threshold_without_provenance_is_refusable.py). The migration script builds {probe path -> ticket id} by loading every ticket JSON and reading ticket['watchme']['probe']; a probe file whose path is a key is owned by that ticket (88 of 104). The second lookup is a module-level constant in the probe source matching ^(_OWNING_TICKET|TICKET|_TICKET) = '<12 hex>' (15); the third is the one ticket JSON whose text contains the probe's file stem, excluding 336a781018ba itself (18); none of the three -> no ticket (1).

D10: roots= is the keyword every cairn probe already takes as its isolation seam (pattern: cairn/tools/base/probes/bounce_returns_to_sender.py, cairn.tools.base.address.resolve): a dict {'repo'|'commons'|'instance': Path} that address.resolve(<root>/<sub>, roots) resolves against instead of the live ~/dev/src/cairn, ~/dev/src/CairnCommons, ~/.cairn. A proof passes roots={'instance': <tmp dir>} so the probe's runs.jsonl lands under the scratch tree and the live instance-space is never written by a proof. The WATCHME probe's file is resolve('instance/devices', roots)/cairn/0/tools/base/threshold_census/runs.jsonl — Law 6's shape: the tool (threshold_census, held by the cairn device, instance 0) berths its ongoing state under <instance root>/devices/<device>/<instance>/tools/<tool class>/. The census itself takes repo_root= (default: the repo this module sits in, Path(__file__).parents[4]) so a proof can point it at a scratch tree of probes.
decisions.step: unlisted: roots= and the instance-space path

decisions.text: D11: 'sealed twice bare and hollow' = three runs of the tester over the proof, all green: 'bare' is the proof run as-is against the working tree, twice (python3 -m cairn.devices.tester.cli --seal --timeout 600 <proof>, run two times — never trust the first green), which writes the validation record beside the code at cairn/tools/base/validations/test_threshold_provenance.json; 'hollow' is the tester's hollow reading (python3 -m cairn.devices.tester.cli --hollow 336a781018ba --seal) which, in a scratch worktree at HEAD, reverts each file the decompose berth's writes_to names to its pre-build state one at a time and re-runs the proof — every reverted file must turn a declared tooth red, or that file reads HOLLOW and the seal refuses. The hollow evidence lands in the same validation record. Together they are Law 8's bar: a proof a hollow build could not pass.

D12: D6's 'five consecutive zeros after a zero' means the LAST SIX lines of runs.jsonl all read provenance_less == 0 — a first zero and five subsequent runs holding it — with total on the sixth line minus total on the first of the six >= 2. Fewer than six lines, any nonzero in the window, or growth under 2 -> not enough. Implemented as held(runs) in the probe module; the two numbers are its declared Thresholds, set_by ticket 336a781018ba (watchme.enough names 5 and 2).

D13 (settles D4's hand table): the migration script's table for ambiguous probes is a dict keyed by repo-relative probe path (e.g. 'cairn/devices/cc/probes/the_shim_delivers_mail.py') whose value is the 12-hex ticket id, or None for a file the migration must not touch; the script consults this table FIRST, before watchme.probe, the module constant, and the one-ticket-names-the-stem lookup (D9). An ambiguous probe absent from the table gets ticket None and set_by 'guess by CC <date>, no ticket, no observation' — it is not an error, it is a silent probe the sieve keeps counting until a hand names its ticket. The table as built: the_shim_delivers_mail.py (cc)->078476729bca, the_shim_delivers_mail.py (codemother)->6b06fcb499fa, a_client_reaches_and_never_beats.py->fc93d8cd5961, edit_survival_probe.py->6d3e689b0bf8, offload_yield_probe.py->d7b4019d2407, history_integrity.py->None (no enough).

D14 (settles D10's path): the WATCHME probe's runs file resolves to /home/akien/.cairn/devices/cairn/0/tools/base/threshold_census/runs.jsonl on the live box — resolve('instance/devices', roots) / 'cairn' / '0' / 'tools' / 'base' / 'threshold_census' / 'runs.jsonl' (address.py:110 resolve; Law 6: a tool's ongoing state berths under the holder, cairn instance 0, that assembled it). Under a proof's scratch roots table {'repo','commons','instance'} the same expression lands under <scratch>/instance/devices/cairn/0/tools/base/threshold_census/runs.jsonl. The pattern is the roots= keyword every address helper takes (address.py:110-130), nothing else.

D15 (settles D11's commands): the tester CLI is python3 -m cairn.devices.tester.cli; a bare seal is '--seal --timeout 600 cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_threshold_provenance.py' (writes cairn/tools/base/validations/test_threshold_provenance.json, a JSON list, latest entry last); the hollow reading is '--hollow 336a781018ba --seal' (reverts each decompose-berth writes_to file in a scratch worktree at the pre-BUILDME commit and reports which declared tooth redded; a file that reds nothing reads HOLLOW). Both already exist and are the commands every voyage since 30531f6e1c5d has run; nothing tester-side is built here.

D16 (settles D2's registration): a sieve joins build_inspector in two acts — (a) def probe_thresholds_declare_provenance(row, comp_dir) in inspector.py, registered in the SIEVES dict (inspector.py:3547) under its own name; (b) a descriptor file cairn/machines/build_inspector/sieves/probe_thresholds_declare_provenance.json with exactly the fields every existing descriptor carries: {"name": "probe_thresholds_declare_provenance", "band": 1, "band_name": "record", "dials": {}} — band 1/record because the sieve scores a component's rows (bands are phases: 0 preprocess, 1 record, 2 postprocess); dials empty because the sieve has no tunable number. The live|disabled band of a FINDING is a value in the finding (values.band), not a descriptor field. Findings ride _finding(method, component, about, expected=0, actual=1, file=, band=, thresholds=, error=) at inspector.py:95; extra kwargs land under entry['values'].

D17 (settles D4's invocation): the migration is a one-time scratch script (migrate_thresholds.py, run once with 'plan' then 'apply' from the session scratchpad before the build commit), NOT a bin/cmd and NOT a build step — its product is the diff on the 112 probe modules, which the proof and the sieve then judge; the script itself is not shipped. Lookup order per D13: the hand table first (overrides everything), then watchme.probe, then the module constant, then the one ticket naming the stem, then None. D13 IS the table's schema: dict keyed by repo-relative probe path, value a 12-hex ticket id or None.

D18 (settles D6's shapes): threshold_census.census(root) returns {root, total, with_enough, provenance_less, provenance_less_paths, disabled_total, disabled_provenance_less, disabled_provenance_less_paths, probes} — total/with_enough/provenance_less count the LIVE band only; the disabled_* trio is the probes_disabled band beside it (D8); probes is every row. Each runs.jsonl line the WATCHME probe appends is {at, provenance_less, total, with_enough, added_since_last, silent, disabled_total, disabled_provenance_less, disabled_silent}. There is no stamp_read or on_read anywhere in this ticket — those are DataRecorder's doors under a4c2be029f49 and do not apply; runs.jsonl is append-only and read whole by held(runs).

D19 (settles D7's teeth): the parallel proofs are cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_probe.py (builds bare Probe(...) instances and exercises the frozen refusals) and cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_inspector.py (a synthetic tree pins a sieve's fire-and-stay-quiet). PROVES is a module-level dict {"336a781018ba": {"all": "test_the_declaration_the_census_the_sieve_and_the_watch"}} — one composite tooth because the falsifier is unnumbered (proof_coverage.clauses(ticket) -> ['all']). Concrete teeth: Threshold(5, '', set_by='x') raises ValueError; Threshold(5, 'runs', set_by='') raises ValueError; Threshold(lambda: 5, 'runs', set_by='x') raises TypeError; Probe(..., thresholds=[Threshold(...)]) (a list) raises TypeError; Probe(..., enough=f, thresholds=()) CONSTRUCTS (D2: no refusal at construction); census over a planted tree of 7 live probes (silent, declared, blank_set_by, blank_of, no_enough, enough_none, broken) reads total 7, with_enough 4, provenance_less 4 [blank_of, blank_set_by, broken, silent] and disabled band 1/1 for probes_disabled/dormant.py; the sieve over that tree emits 5 findings carrying values.band and 0 over a declared component; the live corpus reads 0 provenance-less in both bands; the WATCHME probe is enough only on the 7th pulse over a scratch roots table when the last six lines read 0 and the total grew by 2.

D20: the descriptor is created as D16 spells it — {"name": "probe_thresholds_declare_provenance", "band": 1, "band_name": "record", "dials": {}} — and nothing else; it is the seed the_seed_versus_living_delta.py and gate_parameters_adjust_from_feedback.py read (cairn/tools/base/probes/, _SEEDS_DIR).
decisions.step: unlisted: Create sieve descriptor JSON file at cairn/machines/build_inspector/sieves/probe_thresholds_declare_provenance.json

decisions.text: D21 (the build's steps, in order, each a file the builder creates or edits — nothing else is built): (1) edit cairn/tools/base/probe.py: add the frozen Threshold dataclass and Probe.thresholds per D1/D2; (2) CREATE cairn/tools/base/threshold_census.py: importless AST census with probe_files(root), read_probe(path), census(root) returning the D18 shape, main() printing both bands and returning rc 1 if either is nonzero; (3) edit cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py: add and register the sieve per D16; (4) CREATE cairn/machines/build_inspector/sieves/probe_thresholds_declare_provenance.json per D16/D20; (5) run the one-time migration per D4/D13/D17 over the 107 enough-bearing probe modules at HEAD (103 live, 4 disabled); (6) CREATE cairn/tools/base/probes/a_threshold_without_provenance_is_refusable.py per D6/D10/D12/D14; (7) CREATE cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_threshold_provenance.py per D7/D19. Steps 2, 4, 6, 7 create files that do not exist at HEAD; steps 1, 3 edit files that do; step 5 edits 107.

D22 (settles D5's mechanism): the re-measurement at build time is threshold_census.main() run over the repo root (python3 -m cairn.tools.base.threshold_census) — it prints '<n> probes, <m> with enough, 0 provenance-less ...; disabled band: 4 probes, 0 provenance-less' and returns rc 0 only at zero in both bands; the same measurement is pinned by the proof's live-corpus tooth (D19) and by the validate berth's second criterion, so it is checked three ways: the command, the proof, the verdict. It is not a step inside the migration script.

D23 (settles D6's roots= confusion): roots= is NOT a parameter of the Probe class; it is the keyword every helper in cairn/tools/base/address.py takes (resolve(address, roots=None) at :110, instance_path(..., roots=None) at :123) — a dict {'repo','commons','instance'} of Paths, None meaning the live three roots. The WATCHME probe's own functions (runs_path, read_runs, record_run) take roots= and repo_root= as keywords and read them from the pulse context (context.get('roots'), context.get('repo_root')); the live pulse hands neither. threshold_census.py is created by step 2 of D21 before the probe (step 6) reads it.

D24 (settles D8's standing): the probes_disabled/ read in open_for_akien is not pending — Akien pre-approved every cast ticket through BUILDME/PROVEME on 2026-09-17 ('the review queue is not a hold; only an open question holds a ticket'), and no question on this point is open. D8 is the decision in force: counted, banded separately. If Akien later says otherwise it is a later line on the record (Law 7), not a hold on this build. The builder proceeds under D8 as written.
D25: step 4 of D21 — the descriptor file is created with exactly the D16/D20 content; it is listed as its own step so no reader has to infer it.
decisions.step: unlisted: Create sieve descriptor JSON file

decisions.text: D26 (settles D18's 'silent'): census() returns no 'silent' key — the probe writes runs.jsonl's 'silent' from census()['provenance_less_paths'] and 'disabled_silent' from census()['disabled_provenance_less_paths']; 'silent' is the list of paths, 'provenance_less' is its length. The rename is the probe's: a line names the probes still silent about their number.

D27 (settles D4's remaining three): (a) D4's 'probes_disabled/ outside the census' is superseded by D8 — read D4 with that clause struck; (b) the migration script reads every CairnCommons/tickets/*.json with json.load (id from the 'id' field or the filename's first 12 hex), finds module constants with the regex ^(_OWNING_TICKET|TICKET|_TICKET) = '<12hex>' over the source, and matches a file stem by substring against json.dumps(ticket) excluding 336a781018ba; (c) the script is NOT shipped — it is a scratch script CC wrote and ran once (D17); its product, the 107-file diff, is what ships and what the proof judges. Nothing in the repo depends on the script existing.

D28 (settles D6's three): (a) the complete runs.jsonl line is D18's — {at, provenance_less, total, with_enough, added_since_last, silent, disabled_total, disabled_provenance_less, disabled_silent}; (b) the probe fires on the shim's PULSE (every probe in a probes/ folder is pulsed by the ground loop's discovery), and each pulse runs the census once via once(context, 'threshold_census_run', ...) — watchme.trigger's 'each build_inspector run' is satisfied because the sieve runs the same census() inside the inspector; the probe's OWN clock is the pulse; (c) carry returns {ticket, at, provenance_less, total, with_enough, added_since_last, silent, disabled_total, disabled_provenance_less, disabled_silent, runs_at_zero, held, finding} where finding is one sentence stating the count, the growth and whether the window has held.

READ D4 WITH D13 (the whole list governs, later over earlier): D13 is D4's hand table — a dict keyed by repo-relative probe path, value the 12-hex ticket id or None, consulted FIRST. D4's lookup order is therefore: D13's table, then watchme.probe, then the module TICKET/_OWNING_TICKET constant, then the one-ticket-names-the-stem lookup (D9); an ambiguous probe absent from the table gets ticket None and D13's set_by wording. Nothing in D4 stands apart from D13.

READ D6 WITH D14 THROUGH D19 (the whole list governs): D6 names the WATCHME probe's role and cross-run memory; D14-D19 are its completion and are not optional reading — the probe's fields, its Threshold declaration, the census call, the runs.jsonl berth, the enough clause and the proof's teeth each land in the later line that settles them. Where a later line and D6 differ, the later line is the build.

READ D7 WITH D19 (the whole list governs): D7 names the proof file and what it must show; D19 is its tooth list and the PROVES shape — one composite tooth 'test_the_declaration_the_census_the_sieve_and_the_watch' under clause 'all' because the falsifier is unnumbered. The builder writes the teeth exactly as D19 lists them; D7 adds only the seal requirement (sealed twice, bare and hollow).

D17 AND D27 GOVERN D4's script: migrate_thresholds.py does not exist anywhere (measured 2026-09-25: find over the repo returns 0 files) and is not supposed to — CC writes it in the session scratchpad from D4+D13+D27's spec, runs it once ('plan' then 'apply') before the build commit, and never ships it. The product is the probe-module diff.
